selection.duplicate_resolution: D1 and D2 leaf meshes have identical points (max difference 0) and face connectivity. Frame meshes have identical face connectivity and point differences below 0.72 micrometers. Each pair has 492/2050 source faces and 640/1786 points. They bind separate material/texture sets; D2 is a material variant of D1, so only D1 is counted. Preview meshes are display copies and excluded.

license_dependency_review: Eight 2K JPGs are embedded in the CC BY 4.0 USDZ, with no separately stated dependency terms; four belong to D1 and four to the excluded D2 variant. Selected source retains all packaged maps for audit, but only D1 material is bound.
